    • DEFAULT

      public static final PhysicalKeyboardPolicy DEFAULT
      Default layout for physical keyboards defined in Android.

    • AUTOMATIC

      public static final PhysicalKeyboardPolicy AUTOMATIC
      Layout set with the current Locale. Physical Keyboard is defined by system language.

    • CUSTOM

      public static final PhysicalKeyboardPolicy CUSTOM
      User defined preference. Physical Keyboard Layout is defined by PropertyID.PHYSICAL_KEYBOARD_PROFILE.
